content.short: LudoTON is a TON-based Telegram game that turns classic ludo-style strategy, luck, and competition into play-to-earn matches.
content.description: LudoTON adapts the familiar ludo board-game format for Telegram and TON users. The project presents itself as a play-to-earn game where players compete through a mix of strategy and chance, improve their results over time, and aim to earn TON rewards. It belongs in the games category because its main product is gameplay, not DeFi or wallet infrastructure. Step into the vibrant and exciting world of LudoTON, delightful blend of strategy, luck, and fun. LudoTON remains a game listing because progression, play, competition, collection, or rewards are the main user activity.
